text:
QUOTE: A rejected section logs a WARNING, and the build falls back to the whole-repo tier with the rejection stated as the reason. An absent section falls back silently with a reason saying none was declared.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that a declared `.clew.yaml` `index_scope` is preferred (it wins over the whole-repo tier). It also says that both a rejected section and an absent one fall back to whole-repo indexing.
